children: CNO Financial Group issued an investor briefing presenting growth strategies and performance for its Worksite Division and Medicare business.
Presented investor briefing posted to the company IR site covering Worksite and Medicare businesses and future updates.
Worksite: 18% NAP CAGR since 2020, focus on middle-income employers and in-person enrollment with expansion opportunities.
Worksite distribution: captive agents, direct employer engagement and plans to grow agent footprint in underpenetrated regions.
Medicare: emphasizes structural growth—exclusive Bankers Life distribution, rising Medicare supplement sales and solid persistency.
Company highlighted disciplined rate actions, improving benefit ratios and commitment to pricing, agent development and margin management.
